priya (product): quick sync 1: pick a webinar angle that actually moves engineers to trial Dedicated capacity. options: reliability narratives vs cost-first. leaning reliability.

lila (growth): reliability beats cost for mid-market platform teams. CTA should be "request capacity consult" and a short survey to qualify qps. route >25 qps to AE.

andres (eng): i'll demo a routing + cache-warmup flow. live demo risk -> propose 2m live + 90s recorded fallback. i'll prep a 30s "what broke" clip to make failover obvious.

zain (content): draft abstract: "Reliability narratives for LLM features: step-by-step patterns that prevent downtime and protect UX". will include 3 micro-case bullets.

priya (product): run-of-show (30m): 00:00 Intro (Lila) 03:00 Product goals & SLA story (Priya) 08:00 Demo (Andres) 13:00 Case bullets & metrics (Priya + Zain) 18:00 Q&A (panel) 27:00 CTA & next steps (Lila).

sasha (marketing-ops): logistics: record full demo + 30s social clip, captions, Spanish captions, rehearsal T-1 day, tech check 30m prior. greenroom will host fallback clip.

lila (growth): lead form fields: company size, deployment preference, qps estimate. tags: "reliability-track" and "dedicated-interest". webhook to CRM staging test by Mon.

andres (eng): upload benchmark CSV (p95/p99, cost per 1M tokens) + slide images by Fri.

zain (content): social headlines: A) "Keep your LLM feature online during spikes" B) "Design fallbacks without breaking UX". will prepare A/B copies.

greenroom-bot: rehearsal reserved: Thu 09:00 PT - "Reliability narratives" rehearsal. invites sent.

calendar-bot: promo start T-21 days, target 900 regs, email cadence T-14, T-7, T-2.

priya (product): action items: priya: slides + case details (Mon); andres: demo + CSV (Fri); zain: abstract + social (Tue); lila: promo plan + webhook test (Mon); ops: book AV + localization (in flight).

lila (growth): agreed on CTA order: 1) quick survey (use-case + qps) 2) request consult 3) download benchmark kit. will A/B test consult vs kit.

priya (product): thanks all. tech check Thu 08:30 PT, rehearsal 09:00 PT. I'll post final runbook here after rehearsal.
